notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44397978/3e8c3f2da15dbb176dd09358e1c2d85160f2bca0.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Demo has been updated![/h1][p]Thanks to player feedback, the newest version now has some major changes:[/p][list][*][p]Enemy fire rates have been increased to provide more challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad support completely revamped for better control![/p][/*][*][p]Deon's ability and fire rate has been adjusted for balancing.[/p][/*][*][p]Lar's slowmo ability now increases his fire-rate as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Score staling starts decreasing max score per enemy by a slower rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses "Time Bonus" now decreases at a more competitive rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Shield Enemy has a more obvious weakspot.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss battles have their speed increased at early stages.[/p][/*][*][p]And some minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Thank you for playing my demo and hope to see you at launch![/h2]

tags.balance_change: Enemy fire rates have been increased to provide more challenge.

tags.feature: Gamepad support completely revamped for better control!

tags.balance_change: Deon's ability and fire rate has been adjusted for balancing.
Lar's slowmo ability now increases his fire-rate as well.
Score staling starts decreasing max score per enemy by a slower rate.
Bosses "Time Bonus" now decreases at a more competitive rate.
Shield Enemy has a more obvious weakspot.
Boss battles have their speed increased at early stages.
